verdicts.reason: A is broken. The 'with your next cup of coffee' subhead is huge and sits right on the busy sweater photo, while 'GET A GIFT' has shrunk to a small caption, so the hierarchy is upside down. 'Only this Christmas' and the stars also collide with the photo, and the dashed dividers run through the image. B keeps the headline dominant and crops the photo cleanly with no text on it, but the left column is cramped and ragged: the logo/gift block and the copy block sit on different axes, the dashed rules are misaligned and of uneven length, the stars are oversized, and the URL is tiny.
